title: Decision
description: The outcome of evaluating an ActionIntent. The effect vocabulary is deliberately the FULL enterprise set so a local decision and a centrally-returned decision share one schema and no redesign is needed later. The OSS evaluator implements allow/deny/warn only and MUST report the others as unsupported rather than silently downgrading them.

effect.description: Ordered by increasing restriction. Combination is forbid-overrides: the most restrictive matching effect wins, so adding a policy can never widen access. This ordering mirrors the enterprise policy engine exactly.

supportedLocally.description: False when the effect requires capability this build does not have (approval surfaces, credential brokering, step-up). The caller MUST NOT treat an unsupported effect as an allow.

reason.description: Human-readable, for whoever reads a denial at 03:00.

reasonCodes.description: Machine-matchable, for rules and dashboards. Emitted ALONGSIDE reason, never instead of it. First-occurrence order: the first code is the gate that fired first.

policySetHash.description: Hash of the evaluated policy set. Makes a decision reproducible: without it, a decision cannot be replayed and therefore cannot be evidence.

constraints.description: Obligations attached to a non-deny effect. ADVISORY unless the enforcement point honours them — a constraint that nothing applies must never be reported as applied.
